seo.title: Lunar and Biodynamic Calendar September 2026
seo.description: Lunar biodynamic calendar for hair and skin care in September 2026 at Salón Pilar Palomares. Discover the best days for your haircut, color, and hair removal.

hero.desc: When beauty follows the rhythm of nature
hero.imgAlt: Cosmos biodynamic calendar: lunar rhythms for conscious beauty

agua.desc: Just as the moon governs the tides, it also influences the water that makes up 70% of our body. At Pilar Palomares, we use this ancestral knowledge to enhance the effectiveness of each biotherapy.
agua.imgAlt: The rhythm of water and lunar influence: water nymphs under the full moon, representing the cosmobiological connection

septiembre.introText1: September invites us to live in harmony with the seasonal transition and nature's rhythms. It is a key time to care with awareness: regenerating, balancing, and strengthening hair and skin after the summer months.
septiembre.introText2: Biodynamics reminds us of the importance of supporting this cycle with respect, enhancing hair vitality and skin balance in tune with the most favorable moon phases.

corte.desc: Hair responds faithfully to lunar cycles. September offers very precise windows for cutting depending on your desired outcome: sealing ends, strengthening roots and stopping hair loss, enhancing curls, or boosting growth.
corte.d5_19: On these dates, cutting helps keep the ends more sealed and protected.
corte.d11_15: During this period, cutting contributes to strengthening the hair and curbing fall.
corte.d24_25: The ideal moment to pamper and enhance the natural shape of your curls.
corte.d25_28: Cutting hair on these days favors and stimulates faster, healthier growth.

color.desc: The moon directly influences how hair absorbs and retains color. Choosing the right days makes all the difference in radiance, intensity, and longevity. September offers optimal windows to enhance tones and seal organic pigments.
color.d7_15_16: The perfect moment for color to express all its natural luminosity.
color.d9_11: Applying color on these days enhances tone intensity and rich depth.
color.d11_15: The optimal period to lock in color and extend its longevity.

depil.desc: The descending moon accompanies hair removal processes, helping space out sessions, slowing hair regrowth, and preserving skin softness and balance.
depil.d7: Descending moon: ideal day for hair removal, helping slow down hair regrowth.
depil.d15_16: Optimal period for hair removal and skin calming, prolonging smooth feeling.
depil.imgAlt: Skin care and biodynamic hair removal in September 2026

cta.desc: Book your appointment at Salón Pilar Palomares during the most favorable lunar dates, or ask us any questions about your customized biotherapy.
